description: This Java class 'Transaction' represents a payment transaction entity in the system. It is a JPA entity mapped to the database table 'SM_TRANSACTION' within the sales manager schema. The class includes fields such as id, order, amount, transaction date, transaction type, payment type, details, and a map for additional transaction details. It implements interfaces for auditing and JSON serialization, and contains methods for accessing and modifying its fields, as well as converting transaction details to JSON string.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing a payment transaction, including fields for id, associated order, amount, date, types, details, and audit information. Implements JSON serialization and auditing interfaces.
